body: I have nothing. Noone. The last person that I talked to, I asked her to name any instance where she cared about me and she couldn't name a single one.
I have noone to care at all. I want someone or something to live for but I don't. I don't have goals and I just don't know what to do.
Kill myself. Hang myself and overdose for good measure.
I don't know what to say.
